candidates.label: Tezos X Mainnet
candidates.summary: Kernel 7.1 mainnet deployment is confirmed. The roadmap now lists an Ongoing H2 2026-H1 2027 rollout and Live Aug 2026 Michelson/NAC activation via Ganesha. Gradual explorer, wallet and dApp integrations do not declare the full launch; Full Tezos X rollout remains unconfirmed.
candidates.nextSignal: Explicit full Tezos X rollout declaration tied to deployment and operator compatibility
candidates.highlight: Ganesha proposed Michelson/NAC infrastructure. Kernel deployment and full Tezos X rollout are separate claims.

gates.label: Runtime hardening
gates.detail: Roadmap marks Michelson/NAC Live on mainnet since August 2026 via Ganesha; full-rollout scope stays separate.

gates.label: Previewnet stability
gates.detail: Previewnet outbox recovered October 26 11:33:12 UTC; November 10 maintenance ended 05:58:36 UTC. Stability remains validating.

gates.label: Node and tooling compatibility
gates.detail: EVM node 0.69 published November 19 and is required before storage version 70+ kernels (Etherlink 8.0). Ganesha requires 0.64 or later and a restart for Michelson RPCs.

gates.label: Mainnet proposal readiness
gates.detail: Ganesha is public: SLOW 40/41 in August; FAST 856/857 advanced 00e65e70dcbb9968 on November 10. Votes do not prove deployment.

gates.label: Etherlink governance
gates.detail: FAST 636/637 record the kernel 7.1 proposal and promotion. Newer FAST 693/694 record a September 16 proposal and promotion; governance receipts alone do not establish the full Tezos X rollout.

gates.label: Production rollout
gates.detail: Etherlink reports kernel 7.1 mainnet maintenance completed August 29. Its deployment is confirmed; a separate declaration of the full Tezos X rollout is still required.
